(Plan Question 5.4.1f) • The Lead Agency does not require an annual unannounced inspection for licensed centers and licensed family child care, or an annual inspection for license-exempt centers for compliance with pre-service or orientation training requirements related to the prevention of child maltreatment, as required by 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B) and 98.42(b)(2)(ii). (Plan Questions 5.5.1aii, 5.5.1bii, and 5.5.2ai) Overall Target Completion Date: 05/30/2027 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 The Lead Agency does not require pre-service or orientation training on prevention of child maltreatment for licensed centers, licensed family child care, license-exempt centers, and license- exempt in-home providers, as required by 98.44(b)(1)(i). 05/30/2027 2 Request approval for a regulation package 09/30/2025 3 Prepare and release notice of proposed regulation changes for pre-service or orientation training requirements 12/31/2025 4 Public comment on new regulation 03/01/2026 5 Legislative approval of regulation 06/30/2026 6 Update approved/required training to include prevention of child maltreatment 09/30/2026 7 Identify phase in process of additional topic requirement 09/30/2026 8 Update Child Care Database 12/31/2026 9 Disseminate information on new requirements to impacted entities 03/31/2027 10 Amend plan and submit evidence/required documentation 05/30/2027 11 The Lead Agency does not require an annual unannounced inspection for licensed centers and licensed family child care, or an annual inspection for license-exempt centers for compliance with pre-service or orientation training requirements related to the prevention of child maltreatment, as required by 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B) and 98.42(b)(2)(ii). 05/30/2027 12 Update CC-98 checklist to include missing component 12/31/2026 13 Update Child Care Database 12/31/2026 14 Submit plan amendment and updated checklist 05/30/2027

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not require and conduct NCIC NSOR name-based background checks for all existing child care staff members, as required by 98.43(b)(2), 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B), and 98.43(a). (Plan Questions 5.7.3a and 5.7.3b) • The Lead Agency does not require and conduct NCIC NSOR name-based checks for individuals age 18 or older who reside in an existing family child care home, as required by 98.43(b)(2), 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B), and 98.43(a). (Plan Question 5.7.3c) Overall Target Completion Date: 05/30/2027 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 The Lead Agency does not require and conduct NCIC NSOR name-based background checks for all existing child care staff members, as required by 98.43(b)(2), 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B), and 98.43(a). 05/30/2027 2 Continue conducting conduct NCIC NSOR name- based background checks for child care staff members who are new, transferring facilities, and renewing background check requirements 05/30/2027 3 The Lead Agency does not require and conduct NCIC NSOR name-based checks for individuals age 18 or older who reside in an existing family child care home, as required by 98.43(b)(2), 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B), and 98.43(a). 05/30/2027 4 Continue conducting conduct NCIC NSOR name- based background checks for child care staff members who are new, transferring facilities, renewing background check requirements, and for individuals age 18 or older who reside in an existing family child care home 05/30/2027

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency has not established a standard for the prevention of sudden infant death syndrome and use of safe sleep practices for license-exempt centers and license- exempt in-home care, as required by 98.41(a)(1)(ii). (Plan Questions 5.3.2iv and 5.3.2vi) • The Lead Agency does not require an annual inspection for license-exempt centers for compliance with a standard for the prevention of sudden infant death syndrome and use of safe sleep practices, as required by 98.42(b)(2)(ii). body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not require and conduct interstate criminal history background checks for all staff members (or prospective staff members) who resided in other state(s) in the past 5 years, as required by 98.43(b)(3)(i)(B), 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B), and 98.43(a). (Plan Questions 5.7.6a and 5.7.6b) • The Lead Agency does not require and conduct interstate criminal history background checks for all individuals age 18 or older who reside in a family child care home and resided in other state(s) in the past 5 years, as required by 98.43(b)(3)(i)(B), 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B), and 98.43(a). (Plan Question 5.7.6c) • The Lead Agency does not require and conduct interstate CAN registry checks for all staff members (or prospective staff members) who resided in other state(s) in the past 5 years eligible for CCDF participation, as required by 98.43(b)(3)(iii), 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B), and 98.43(a).
